question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Competition and cooperation are the most ______ elements of a company’s success story.
solution:
The correct answer is "important."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word** "important" **means having great value or influence; very necessary. (महत्वपूर्ण; अत्‍यावश्‍यक)

 
 
• **Example**: *This is an **important**__ decision.*
 
 
 
• In the context of a company's success story, competition and cooperation are fundamental and indispensable elements.
 
• They play a vital role in shaping the outcome and overall success of the company.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *Competition and cooperation are the most **__important__** elements of a company’s success story.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Insignificant: **of little value or importance. (महत्वहीन, उपेक्षणीय, नगण्य, निरर्थक)
 
• **Useless: **that does not work well, that does not achieve anything. (अनुपयोगी, बेकार (जो ठीक से काम न करे, जिससे कोई काम न सधे जो किसी काम का न हो))
 
• **Inappropriate: **not suitable. (अनुपयुक्त)
